$comment: Feature workflow (D3): define -> design -> implement -> test -> deploy -> close. JSON (not YAML) because hooks are bash and jq is available. Read this with jq, e.g. `jq '.phases[] | select(.phase=="define")' feature.json`. Phases are listed in run order; `order` is 1-based and matches array position. `owner_agent` is the plugin agent that owns the phase's artifact (D4) — only that agent may write it (REQ-005). `artifact` is the filename inside the session folder that phase creates/owns, or null for Close, which produces no session file (D1). `milestone` is the name shown to the user at the milestone gate and used in gh comments (D5); `gh_label` is the label applied while that phase is active. `conversational` marks phases that talk to the user directly through the orchestrator (Define, Design) vs. phases that mostly execute (D3 main loop, D4).

github.$comment: One-time label setup (D5, skills/session/scripts/gh-setup.sh): one type:* label plus each phase's gh_label, colors from design.md's D5 one-time-setup block.
